_meta.notes: Breaking Ground not installed: muted empty state, no rotors. `robotics.available` is deliberately ABSENT rather than false. Without the expansion the Uplink goes Unavailable and never emits on that channel at all, so a fixture setting it false encoded the confusion the widget used to have: it read `available === false` as 'the DLC is missing' when that value actually means 'this craft carries no robotic part'. The DLC fact comes off `game.dlc.breakingGround`, which is ground-side and independent of any vessel.

_scene.caption: Breaking Ground not installed: the dial is withheld entirely rather than drawn at zero RPM
_scene.expectsEmpty: There are no rotors without the DLC. A dial parked at 0 RPM would read as a rotor that is stopped, which is a reading; this scene exists to show that none is drawn.
